title: 日経新春杯の後に・急襲！新ライバル

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto finishes the race with good results. By my analysis, not only is she performing well, she's showing she can hold her own in her senior-year graded races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Matikanefukukitaru thwarts our eager procession toward the spring G1. Our next goal, and preliminary for the G1, becomes the Kinko Sho.
